# Upstream YouTubeWindows dependency

This directory is intentionally kept free of upstream source and binaries. Obtain the client from [TGSAN/YouTubeWindows](https://github.com/TGSAN/YouTubeWindows) under that project's distribution terms and place the runtime files here for a local package. Required entry point: `YouTubeWindows.exe`. Keep its own runtime files adjacent as supplied. The launcher does not fetch, build, modify, or redistribute upstream artifacts.
